title: AC1027 HEADER suffix retry after second user unlock
scope: One fresh bounded retry of the existing AC1027 Cover source after the user said they were unlocking the Mac; determine whether the installed ODA File Converter CLI reaches document processing.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local source; no DWG/DXF fixture was created or added to the repository.

converter.result: ABORT (SIGABRT, return code -6) after 0.5 seconds during PasteBoard/XPC initialization; stdout empty; no document processing or output file.
converter.stderrExcerpt: PasteBoard: Error creating pasteboard: com.apple.pasteboard.clipboard [-4960]; PasteBoard: Error creating pasteboard: com.apple.pasteboard.find [-4960]; invalid com.apple.hiservices-xpcservice connection.

decision: The fresh user unlock did not change the direct CLI launch failure. Do not repeat the identical invocation. The AC1027 suffix remains unclaimed, suffix analysis remains unqualified, and strict output remains refused. Retry only using a changed launch route that reaches document processing, such as a functioning GUI workflow or another verified converter environment.
